name: Stage 58: Kasholmen, Mörkö to Skanssundet
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 58, Kasholmen, Mörkö to Skanssundet.
utilities: Kasholmen/Pålsundet is the start/access node, with official parking/access and nearby Mörkötrafiken/SL stop context. Treat older fixed-bus-785 advice as stale; Mörkötrafiken is now on-demand and must be booked/planned separately.

Norafjärden is the key on-stage overnight/rest cluster after the 2023 reroute: shelter, grill/fireplace, dry toilet, and waterfront rest context. It has no verified drinking water and no confirmed sampled bathing status.

Salsudd/Åbynäs has bathing, toilet, and parking context near the northern part of the stage. Coordinates are strongest from OSM plus Sörmlandsleden's Salsudd mention; no current municipal bathing-service page was found.

Skansholmen/Skanssundet is the services-heavy finish: shop/reception, seasonal food/cafe/ice cream, camping/cabins/hostel, guest harbour, toilets/showers for guests, seasonal marked water taps, paid parking, ferry, and bus/ferry access.
waterSources: No reliable potable mid-stage water was verified. Norafjärden shelter is by brackish coastal water and should not be treated as a drinking-water source.

The only verified refill is the seasonal summer tap at Skansholmens Affär & Café/service area near the finish. Skansholmen asks visitors to be sparing with water; verify opening/season and carry enough water for the whole stage.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Use 10.5 km as the canonical official distance. Naturkartan lists 10.6 km, AllTrails about 10.1 km, Topo GPS/OSM-derived geometry about 11.2 km, and older blogs vary because some predate the 2023 reroute.

Stage 58 was rerouted in 2023 to pass the new Norafjärden shelter and toilet; the official updated map was posted 2023-04-27. Follow current orange markings and avoid older GPX/blog tracks. Naturkartan's exposed geometry appears incomplete/stale here: it measures about 8.6 km and does not pass the Norafjärden shelter area, despite the page showing a 10.6 km length.

Official information listed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass. A 2024 official-page comment said stages 57-58 were well marked, while some 2025 review material still recommends using an offline map around open pasture, the shelter reroute, and clear-cut areas.

OSM relation 7448733 passes close to the Norafjärden shelter and is a better current geometry candidate than Naturkartan, but it has a mapped gap near Skansholmen/Salsudd from about 59.040191, 17.686411 to 59.041779, 17.694478. Treat this as a data-quality warning and follow current waymarks locally.

Cattle/grazing animals may be present in pastures, and an official signed alternative exists for hikers who want to avoid animals. Keep dogs leashed, give livestock space, close gates, and avoid walking between animals and young.

The northern part has clear-cuts, new spruce plantings, rockier height sections, and slippery leaves/rock after rain. Stay on the marked route through forestry areas and avoid stepping on new plantings.

For overnight planning, the Norafjärden shelter is the least ambiguous option. Outside it, apply allemansrätten cautiously: not on cultivated land or pasture, not near houses, no disturbance, and local signs/rules override assumptions.

Stage 58 connects to Stage 59 by ferry, not by a walked trail line. The Mörkö-side endpoint is at Skanssundet/Skansholmen, while Stage 59 starts on the Hörningsnäs side after the free Skanssundsleden ferry.

Skanssundet access depends on the free 330 m Trafikverket road ferry and current bus/Mörkötrafiken arrangements. Trafikverket's page may show stale disruption notices such as old June 2025 closures, so check live ferry/SL/Mörkötrafiken status before committing to public-transport logistics.

Skanssundet and Nora Holmäng have nearby Natura 2000 shore-meadow/grassland context. Stay on marked trail/roads, avoid disturbing birds/livestock, and do not camp, light fires, collect plants, or trample sensitive shore habitat.

facilities.name: Kasholmen stage 58 start
facilities.description: Official Stage 58 start and Stage 57 junction on the Mörkö side of Mörköbron.

facilities.name: Kasholmen parking/access
facilities.description: Official parking/access at the stage start. Independent mapping suggests treating it as limited rather than a large formal lot.

facilities.name: Pålsundet / Mörkötrafiken access
facilities.description: Nearby Pålsundet stop/access context for bookable Mörkötrafiken/SL. Mörkötrafiken replaced old fixed line 785 and has no fixed timetable; book in the app or via SL customer service and verify live planning.

facilities.name: Kasholmsberget viewpoint
facilities.description: Viewpoint/bird-migration and cultural-remains context near the start. Approximate pin from official route description and local topography.

facilities.name: Stage 58 2023 reroute
facilities.description: Official route was rerouted in 2023 to pass the new shelter/toilet area; the updated official map was posted 2023-04-27. Follow current orange markings and avoid older pre-2023 tracks. Naturkartan's exposed line appears incomplete/stale for this reroute.

facilities.name: Norafjärden shelter
facilities.description: New Stage 58 shelter by Norafjärden after the 2023 reroute. Coordinates are high-confidence from official comments/OSM and the current OSM relation passes close to the shelter; Vindskyddskartan plots a nearby but less preferred point.

facilities.name: Norafjärden fireplace/grill
facilities.description: Shelter-area grill/fireplace. Sörmlandsleden shelter guidance says firewood is not supplied; use only when current fire rules allow.

facilities.name: Norafjärden dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet near the Norafjärden shelter, mapped separately in OSM and corroborated by official shelter notes.

facilities.name: Norafjärden brackish water
facilities.description: Water beside the shelter is brackish coastal water, not a verified drinking source, and no sampled bathing-water page was found. Carry water or refill at Skansholmen when open.

facilities.name: Pasture/cattle alternative route
facilities.description: Stage passes grazing animals in pasture. Official material notes a signed alternative route for hikers who want to avoid animal contact. Keep dogs leashed, close gates, and give livestock space.

facilities.name: Clear-cut and new spruce warning
facilities.description: Northern section includes clear-cut/forestry areas, rockier height sections, and new spruce plantings. Stay on the marked trail and protect young plantings; use current map/markers through the 2023 reroute area.

facilities.name: Salsudd / Åbynäs bathing place
facilities.description: Bathing-place context around Salsudd/Åbynäs mentioned by Sörmlandsleden and mapped in OSM. No current municipal sampled-bathing/service page was verified, so check local signs.

facilities.name: Salsudd / Åbynäs toilet
facilities.description: OSM-mapped toilet building near the Salsudd/Åbynäs bathing area. Service level/season was not confirmed by a municipal page.

facilities.name: Salsudd / Åbynäs parking
facilities.description: Parking/access context for the Salsudd/Åbynäs bathing area. Official stage lists Salsudd parking; OSM maps nearby surface parking around Åbynäs/Hölö båtklubb.

facilities.name: Stage 58 mapped route gap
facilities.description: OSM Stage 58 relation has a roughly 494 m topological gap near Skansholmen/Salsudd, and Naturkartan's exposed geometry stops before the ferry/cafe area. Do not infer a straight connector; follow current orange markings on site.

facilities.name: Skansholmen services
facilities.description: Shop/reception, seasonal food/cafe/ice cream, restaurant/bistro, camping, cabins/hostel, guest harbour, toilets/showers for guests, waste room, guest kitchen, sauna/laundry hire, and other services. Verify opening hours.

facilities.name: Skansholmen camping/lodging
facilities.description: Commercial camping, tent/camper pitches, cabins, hostel, and guest-harbour lodging context at the stage finish. Guests have access to service-house toilets/showers; book/check season before relying on it.

facilities.name: Skansholmen summer tap
facilities.description: Seasonal water tap by Skansholmens Affär & Café/service area. Skansholmen marks water points but asks visitors to be sparing and limits larger fills; verify season/opening.

facilities.name: Skansholmen parking
facilities.description: Parking near Skansholmen/Skanssundet. Skansholmen reports paid parking about 150 m from the facility, listed at 15 kr/hour or 180 kr/day in the checked source.

facilities.name: Skanssundet ferry, Mörkö side
facilities.description: Free Trafikverket road ferry across Skanssundet to Hörningsnäs/Södertörn, about 330 m and 3 minutes. Check live status because old disruption notices may remain visible on source pages.

facilities.name: Skanssundet bus/Mörkötrafiken access
facilities.description: Mörkö-side on-demand access near the finish. Use live SL/Mörkötrafiken planning; old fixed line 785 references are stale after the permanent demand-responsive service.

facilities.name: Skanssundet ferry, Hörningsnäs side
facilities.description: North-side ferry terminal with bus 727 connection toward Tumba/Stockholm according to Skansholmen directions.

facilities.name: Skanssundet bus 727 stop
facilities.description: Fixed SL bus 727 access on the Hörningsnäs side after taking the ferry; useful for Tumba/Stockholm connections. Verify current departures in SL.

facilities.name: Nora Holmäng shore-meadow caution
facilities.description: Nearby/start-side Natura 2000 shore-meadow and grassland context. It is private/pasture-dominated land with sensitive shore birds and meadow flora; stay on the marked route and avoid disturbance.

facilities.name: Skanssundet shore-meadow caution
facilities.description: Natura 2000 shore-meadow context near Skanssundet, protecting Baltic coastal meadows and species-rich grasslands. Stay on marked trail/roads and avoid camping, fires, bird disturbance, plant collecting, or trampling sensitive shore habitat.
